name: pix-key-input
description: Smart input for Brazilian Pix keys that auto-detects the key type (CPF, CNPJ, e-mail, telefone, chave aleatória) and applies the appropriate mask.

placeholder.default: CPF, e-mail, telefone ou chave aleatória

behavior.autoDetect: Detects key type as user types: CPF (11 digits), CNPJ (14 digits), e-mail (@+.), phone (10-11 digits), random (UUID format)
behavior.autoMask: Applies CPF/CNPJ/phone masks automatically when type is detected
behavior.badge: Shows colored badge with detected type (CPF=blue, CNPJ=purple, E-mail=amber, Phone=green, Random=gray)
behavior.inputMode: Standard text input to accommodate all key types

context.whenToUse: When collecting a Pix key from a user for transfers or payments
context.whenNotToUse: When you already know the key type — use CPFInput, CNPJInput, or PhoneBR directly
context.culturalNote: Pix keys can be CPF, CNPJ, e-mail, phone number, or a random UUID. The system was introduced by the Central Bank of Brazil in 2020 and is now the most used payment method in the country.
